items.claim: In `tqdm.format_meter`, when `inv_rate` (1/rate) is less than 1 the non-inverted rate form is used, producing e.g. `'18.13it/s'`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `rate_fmt = rate_inv_fmt if inv_rate and inv_rate > 1 else rate_noinv_fmt` selects the non-inverted form `f'{rate:5.2f}' + unit + '/s'` (e.g. '18.13it/s') when inv_rate <= 1.

items.claim: `tqdm._comparable` returns the bar's screen position.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `_comparable` returns `abs(getattr(self, 'pos', 1 << 31))`, i.e. the bar's (absolute) line position.

items.claim: `tqdm.update` feeds the two EMA accumulators when `smoothing` is truthy and both `dt` and `dn` are non-zero.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `if self.smoothing and dt and dn:` guards the calls to `self._ema_dn(dn)` and `self._ema_dt(dt)`.

items.claim: TqdmCallback supports arbitrary tqdm keyword arguments via functools.partial.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `tqdm_kwargs` are bound onto the tqdm class via `partial(tqdm_class, **tqdm_kwargs)`.

items.claim: tqdm.keras provides a TqdmCallback class.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `TqdmCallback` is defined and exported in `tqdm/keras.py`.

items.claim: The PyPI package is built using make build with requirements from .meta/requirements-build.txt and uploaded via casperdcl/deploy-pypi@v3 with GPG signing.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The deploy job installs `.meta/requirements-build.txt`, runs `make build`, and uses `casperdcl/deploy-pypi@v3` with `gpg_key`.

items.claim: `tqdm.__exit__` downgrades a late `AttributeError` to a `TqdmWarning` rather than raising.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `__exit__` catches AttributeError and issues `warn("AttributeError ignored", TqdmWarning)` (re-raising only if no external exception is in flight).

items.claim: TMonitor uses a threading.Event named was_killed to manage shutdown.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `self.was_killed` is created from `threading.Event` and used for shutdown signalling.

items.claim: tqdm maintains a WeakSet of all active instances in tqdm._instances.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `_instances = WeakSet()` is a class attribute to which each new instance is added.

items.claim: In tqdm_notebook, pbar is the progress bar visual element implemented with ipywidgets.FloatProgress aliased as IProgress.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `FloatProgress` is imported as `IProgress` and `pbar = IProgress(...)` is the progress widget.

items.claim: tqdm.contrib.itertools combinations computes total as math.comb(n, r).
items.label: supported
items.reason: `combinations` sets `total = math.comb(n, r)` when total is unspecified.

items.claim: make alltests runs pytest for the current environment.
items.label: unverifiable
items.reason: The Makefile is not shown, so the `alltests` target cannot be checked.

items.claim: `tqdm.__init__` assigns `last_print_t` and `start_t` only after the initial refresh returns.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The initial `self.refresh(...)` is called before `self.last_print_t = self._time()` and `self.start_t = self.last_print_t`.

items.claim: Coveralls is configured with COVERALLS_PARALLEL: true and the finish job calls coveralls --finish.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `COVERALLS_PARALLEL: true` is set in the test job and the finish job runs `coveralls --finish`.

items.claim: For IPython 2.x, tqdm_notebook uses IPython.html.widgets with HTML, FloatProgressWidget and ContainerWidget.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The IPython 2.x fallback imports HTML, ContainerWidget as HBox and FloatProgressWidget as IProgress from IPython.html.widgets.

items.claim: `tqdm.set_description_str` stores the description string verbatim without appending `': '`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `set_description_str` sets `self.desc = desc or ''` with no ': ' appended.

items.claim: tqdm/contrib/slack.py defines aliases tqdm and trange for tqdm_slack.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Aliases `tqdm = tqdm_slack` and `trange = tsrange` are defined.

items.claim: The tqdm parameter `total` defaults to None.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The `__init__` signature declares `total=None`.

items.claim: In `tqdm.__init__`, `last_print_n` and `n` are both set from the `initial` argument.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Both `self.last_print_n` and `self.n` are initialised to `initial`.

items.claim: The CI determines docker_tags and snap_channel based on the branch (master, devel, or a tag).
items.label: supported
items.reason: The collect_assets step sets docker_tags/snap_channel depending on tag, master or devel refs.

items.claim: The auto-detection logic checks os.environ for QT_API and SPYDER.
items.label: supported
items.reason: It checks `any(i == 'QT_API' or i.startswith('SPYDER') for i in os.environ)`.

items.claim: DiscordIO uses API base https://discord.com/api/v10.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `API = 'https://discord.com/api/v10'` in DiscordIO.

items.claim: Telegram integration reads token from TQDM_TELEGRAM_TOKEN and chat id from TQDM_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `@envwrap("tqdm", "telegram")` with documented defaults `${TQDM_TELEGRAM_TOKEN}` and `${TQDM_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}`.

items.claim: The lock created by `get_lock` becomes class state for the rest of the process.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `get_lock` assigns `cls._lock = TqdmDefaultWriteLock()` on the class if absent, so it persists as class-level state.

items.claim: `Bar.__format__` at `frac=1.0` with 10 cells computes `divmod(80, 8) = (10, 0)` and appends no padding because `bar_length` is not less than `N_BARS`, producing ten solid blocks.
items.label: supported
items.reason: UTF charset has 9 chars so nsyms=8; divmod(int(1.0*10*8), 8) == (10, 0) and `bar_length < N_BARS` is False, so only `charset[-1]*10` is returned.

items.claim: tqdm/contrib/telegram.py defines aliases tqdm and trange for tqdm_telegram.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Aliases `tqdm = tqdm_telegram` and `trange = ttgrange` are defined.

items.claim: A comment in `tqdm.__iter__` states that it does not call `self.update(1)` for speed optimisation.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The comment reads '# Note: does not call self.update(1) for speed optimisation.'

items.claim: A CI check ensures the generated wheel size remains under 100kB.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The check job builds a wheel and asserts its byte size is < 102400.

items.claim: `tqdm.update` tolerates a negative `n` by decrementing `last_print_n` to match.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `if n < 0: self.last_print_n += n  # for auto-refresh logic to work`.

items.claim: In `tqdm.__init__`, an explicit `total=float("inf")` is normalised to `None`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `if total == float("inf"): total = None  # same as unknown`.

items.claim: `TMonitor._atexit_signal` only calls `self.was_killed.set()` and does not join.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `_atexit_signal` only calls `self.was_killed.set()`, with a docstring noting it is a non-joining shutdown signal.

items.claim: tqdm.contrib.bells selects Telegram if TQDM_TELEGRAM_TOKEN and TQDM_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are present.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The elif branch imports from .telegram when TQDM_TELEGRAM_TOKEN and TQDM_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are set.

items.claim: `tqdm._decr_instances` removes the instance from `_instances` under the lock, and is called by `close()`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `_decr_instances` removes the instance from `cls._instances` inside `with cls._lock:` and `close()` calls `self._decr_instances(self)`.

items.claim: `tqdm.refresh` returns `True` after displaying and releasing the lock.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `refresh` calls `self.display()`, releases the lock if not nolock, and returns True.

items.claim: `tqdm.update` returns immediately on a disabled bar.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `update` begins with `if self.disable: return`.

items.claim: `EMA.__call__` computes `last = alpha*x + beta*last` and returns it de-biased by dividing by `1 - beta**calls`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: EMA computes `self.last = self.alpha * x + beta * self.last` and returns `self.last / (1 - beta ** self.calls)` when calls > 0.

items.claim: `TMonitor.__init__` takes `tqdm_cls` and `sleep_interval` arguments.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Signature is `def __init__(self, tqdm_cls, sleep_interval)` and both are stored on the instance.

items.claim: `TMonitor.exit()` is the joining variant of shutdown and refuses to join itself.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `exit()` sets the kill event, joins only `if self is not current_thread()`, and returns `self.report()`.

items.claim: tqdm_asyncio.__init__ detects whether the iterable has __anext__, __next__, or is a standard iterable.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `__init__` checks for `__anext__`, `__aiter__`, `__next__`, else falls back to `iter(iterable)`.

items.claim: DiscordIO.write(s) uses self.submit to perform a PATCH request asynchronously.
items.label: supported
items.reason: DiscordIO.write submits `self.session.patch` via `self.submit`, i.e. an asynchronous PATCH request.

items.claim: Under `dynamic_ncols`, `tqdm.format_dict` re-probes the terminal and writes `self.ncols` and `self.nrows`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `if self.dynamic_ncols: self.ncols, self.nrows = self.dynamic_ncols(self.fp)` inside `format_dict`.

items.claim: Inside the lock, `tqdm.__new__` adds the freshly allocated instance to `cls._instances`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `__new__` enters `with cls.get_lock():` and calls `cls._instances.add(instance)` inside it.

items.claim: tqdm_gui uses plt.pause(1e-9) to force UI updates.
items.label: supported
items.reason: tqdm_gui.display ends with `self.plt.pause(1e-9)`.

items.claim: The same `TqdmDefaultWriteLock` object is used by `tqdm.write` and `external_write_mode`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `write` delegates to `external_write_mode`, which acquires the single class-level lock returned by `get_lock()` (a `TqdmDefaultWriteLock`).

items.claim: The CLI option --buf-size sets the buffer size in bytes for reading stdin.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `buf_size` is documented as string buffer size in bytes, exposed as `--buf-size` in help, and passed to `fin.read(buf_size)` on stdin.

items.claim: DummyTqdmFile is an ObjectWrapper that captures write calls and redirects them to tqdm.write().
items.label: supported
items.reason: DummyTqdmFile subclasses ObjectWrapper and its write() buffers and forwards to tqdm.write().

items.claim: The `TMonitor` atexit handler only sets a kill event and never joins the thread.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `_atexit_signal` only calls `self.was_killed.set()` with no join, as documented in its docstring.

items.claim: The first thing `tqdm.__new__` does is `with cls.get_lock():`.
items.label: contradicted
items.reason: The first statement is `instance = object.__new__(cls)`; the lock is acquired only afterwards.

items.claim: make distclean removes build, dist, egg-info, and coverage artifacts.
items.label: unverifiable
items.reason: The Makefile contents are not shown, so the `distclean` target cannot be checked.

items.claim: The tqdm parameter `leave` defaults to True.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `__init__` signature has `leave=True`.

items.claim: The deprecation warning class is TqdmDeprecationWarning.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Class `TqdmDeprecationWarning(TqdmWarning, DeprecationWarning)` is defined as the deprecation warning.

items.claim: In `tqdm.__init__`, the `isatty` check only fires when `disable` is `None`, turning the bar off on a non-TTY stream.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The isatty check is guarded by `disable is None` and sets `disable = True` for non-TTY files.

items.claim: `miniters` may hold a float value because the gate uses a `>=` comparison rather than an index.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Dynamic miniters assigns float expressions and the check is `self.n - self.last_print_n >= self.miniters`, a numeric comparison.

items.claim: tqdm can be inserted as a pipe in a chain of coroutines using a send() based approach without asyncio.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The example inserts tqdm as a pipe between generator coroutines using `send()`/`yield`, explicitly not asyncio.

items.claim: When `ncols` is `None`, nothing trims the rendered line to the console width and the bar is a fixed ten cells.
items.label: supported
items.reason: With falsy `ncols` the bar length defaults to 10 and the result is returned without `disp_trim`.

items.claim: tqdm's CLI entry point is handled by tqdm.cli.main.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The console script is declared as `tqdm = "tqdm.cli:main"`.

items.claim: `tqdm.close` sets `self._ema_dt = lambda: None` before calling `self.display(pos=0)`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: In the `leave` branch `self._ema_dt = lambda: None` precedes `self.display(pos=0)`.

items.claim: Tab completion for bash is implemented in tqdm/completion.sh and provides suggestions for flags and logging levels.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The generator writes tqdm/completion.sh containing compgen word lists of option flags plus a `--log` case with logging levels.

items.claim: `tqdm.format_dict` computes `elapsed` as `self._time() - self.start_t if hasattr(self, 'start_t') else 0`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The `elapsed` entry is exactly `self._time() - self.start_t if hasattr(self, 'start_t') else 0`.

items.claim: tqdm_asyncio automatically calls close() on StopIteration or exceptions during asynchronous iteration.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `__anext__` calls self.close() on StopIteration (raising StopAsyncIteration) and on any BaseException.

items.claim: `tqdm.update` stores `last_print_n` and `last_print_t` and returns `True` when a display happened.
items.label: supported
items.reason: After displaying, `update` stores `last_print_n`/`last_print_t` and returns `True`.

items.claim: New options added to tqdm.std.tqdm but unsupported by the CLI must be added to tqdm.cli.UNSUPPORTED_OPTS.
items.label: supported
items.reason: UNSUPPORTED_OPTS lists options excluded from CLI parsing, which are popped from the docstring-derived option types.

items.claim: The tqdm parameter `unit_scale` defaults to False.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `unit_scale=False` in the `__init__` signature.

items.claim: In `disable_on_exception`'s `inner`, any `OSError` or `ValueError` other than the matched cases is re-raised.
items.label: supported
items.reason: OSError with errno != 5 and ValueError without 'closed' are re-raised; others silently disable.

items.claim: `tqdm._get_free_pos` builds `positions` as `{abs(inst.pos) for inst in cls._instances if inst is not instance and hasattr(inst, "pos")}` and returns `min(set(range(len(positions) + 1)).difference(positions))`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The code matches the quoted set-comprehension and return expression verbatim.

items.claim: `DisableOnWriteError` calls `disable_on_exception` twice, once for `write` and once for `flush`, each returning an `inner` closure set as an attribute on the wrapper.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `__init__` wraps both `write` and `flush` via `disable_on_exception`, each returning the `inner` closure set by `wrapper_setattr`.

items.claim: The CLI option --manpath installs man pages to a specified directory.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `--manpath` triggers copying the packaged `tqdm.1` into the given directory.

items.claim: `tqdm.__new__` only constructs a new `TMonitor` when `cls.monitor_interval` is truthy and `cls.monitor is None or not cls.monitor.report()`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The monitor is created only if `cls.monitor_interval` is truthy and `cls.monitor is None or not cls.monitor.report()`.

items.claim: tqdm._utils.IS_WIN maps to tqdm.utils.IS_WIN.
items.label: supported
items.reason: tqdm/_utils.py re-exports IS_WIN (among others) from tqdm.utils.

items.claim: DisableOnWriteError catches OSError with errno 5 or ValueError for a closed stream and sets miniters to inf.
items.label: supported
items.reason: disable_on_exception catches OSError with errno 5 and ValueError containing 'closed', setting tqdm_instance.miniters = float('inf').

items.claim: In `tqdm.__iter__`, the counter comparison is checked before calling `time()`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `if n - last_print_n >= self.miniters:` guards the `cur_t = time()` call.

items.claim: The tqdm parameter `bar_format` defaults to None.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `bar_format=None` in the `__init__` signature.

items.claim: `tqdm.format_meter` discards `total` and falls back to a counter-only line when `n >= total + 0.5`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: `total` is set to None when `n >= total + 0.5`, leading to the no-bar stats-only return branch.

items.claim: `tqdm.close` with `leave=True` draws one last frame at position 0 and writes `'\n'`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: When leaving, it calls `self.display(pos=0)` then `fp_write('\n')`.

items.claim: `tqdm.__init__` has defaults `desc=None, total=None, leave=True, file=None, ncols=None, mininterval=0.1, maxinterval=10.0, miniters=None, ascii=None, disable=False, unit='it', unit_scale=False, smoothing=0.3, unit_divisor=1000, delay=0.0, gui=False`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: All listed parameter defaults match the signature exactly.

items.claim: post-release.yml updates the repository wiki by running make inside the wiki directory.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The 'Update Wiki Releases' step does `pushd wiki` then `make` then commits/pushes.

items.claim: `tqdm.close` returns silently if `last_print_t` was never set or if `last_print_t < start_t + delay`.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Both early returns are present with those exact conditions.

items.claim: tqdm.contrib.bells selects Slack if TQDM_SLACK_TOKEN and TQDM_SLACK_CHANNEL are present.
items.label: supported
items.reason: The first branch imports from .slack when both TQDM_SLACK_TOKEN and TQDM_SLACK_CHANNEL are set.

items.claim: The Bar class supports HEX color codes (e.g. #00ff00) and standard terminal colors such as RED and GREEN.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Bar.COLOURS includes 'RED' and 'GREEN', and the colour setter parses 7-char '#rrggbb' hex values via COLOUR_RGB.

items.claim: `tqdm.format_meter` returns the line untrimmed when `ncols` is falsy.
items.label: supported
items.reason: Every return uses `disp_trim(..., ncols) if ncols else <untrimmed>`.
